Temperature¶

Temperature is compared in 2 simulations in degrees_C: fv and nm. In the figures, maps are a panel for each simulation, and lines are a colour for each, as in the table.

Simulation Model variable Files Output Dates
fv temp (temperature) aqua_v**_trawl_avg_**_**_**.nc (13) Daily 2012-12-02 to 2014-01-01
nm votemper (temperature) amm7_1d_**_**_grid_T.nc (12) Daily 2013-01-01 to 2013-12-31

Table 1: What Temperature is in each simulation, and the output it is read from. It was converted into the units of fv as it was read: nm, from degC into degrees_C (the same units, written otherwise).

Climatology¶

The climatology of Temperature is its mean in each month of the year over 2013, worked out for each simulation, read from 13 files of fv and 12 files of nm, and the annual mean is the mean of the monthly means. No output is missing in these years from any simulation.
